summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by MainStreet Bancshares reporting results of its annual meeting of shareholders on May 21, 2026, where directors were elected, an accounting firm ratified, and a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation approved. It also discloses a quarterly dividend declaration on its Series A Preferred Stock. There is no special situation such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The filing contains only standard governance and dividend disclosures.
